method: Round-robin selection from top 20 public contributors of 12 explicitly listed mature projects; exclude bots, deduplicate, cap at 100. Five profiles per read-only GraphQL query. Root HEAD:README.md only. Structural heuristics, not individual quality ratings.
limitations: Purposive open-source sample; not representative of all software engineers or hiring success.
Contributor counts do not establish employment, seniority or individual engineering quality.
Missing root README is not an absent profile or evidence of low quality.
No copied biographies or README text. No causal claims about which presentation obtains employment.
Current API observations can change. Private data is discarded.
